rows.name: po_type
rows.comment: Passed in by the check-in container (7days / 14days).

rows.name: po_viewed_7d
rows.action_list:
data_changed | set_field: prox_7d_viewed_ts: @calc(now());
data_changed | add_data |
_list_id: proximal_outcome_views,
viewed_ts: @calc(now()),
po_type: @local.po_type,
access: @fields.prox_outcome_access,
completed_all: @fields.completed_all;
rows.comment: Fires once the intro has been drawn (data_changed), whatever opened it: home button, module, review or notification. Stamps the 7-day 'viewed' time and adds a history row. Looping over the intro's own pages-list row keeps it to one run per view.

rows.name: po_viewed_14d
rows.comment: 14-day check-ins also stamp the 14-day 'viewed' time (as prox_14d_last_ts does for started).

rows.name: intro_during
rows.comment: During the programme, and any check-in not opened from the home button or a notification (modules, hp_review).

rows.name: intro_post
rows.action_list:
completed | emit: completed;
uncompleted | emit: uncompleted;
rows.comment: After programme completion, 14-day check-in from the home button or a notification.
